authorityBoundary: Design references are non-normative. Only pinned applicable legal sources and governed accepted facts may establish an LCSP assessment outcome.

transferablePatterns: Independent critical review before accepting completion
Explicitly separate independent observations, disagreement and synthesis
Treat retrieved content as untrusted data
excludedBehaviors: Treating collected prompts as verified vendor policies or as law
lcspTargets: assessment root investigation and review protocol

transferablePatterns: On-demand skill loading with small discovery metadata
Typed tool boundaries and permission separation
Explicit context compaction and persistence policy
excludedBehaviors: Generic unrestricted bash as legal decision authority
Inferring legal obligations from skill text
Treating generic benchmark scores as legal acceptance
Synthetic gold being counted as human-approved truth

requiredBeforePromptChange: source id + pinned commit + reviewed paths
at least one positive and one negative eval case
requiredBeforePromotion: false-positive, omission, over-question and evidence-precision results
forbidden: copying leaked vendor prompts into runtime system instructions
automatically creating one skill per newly assessed repo
promoting from green unit tests only
assigning legal authority to external design references
